description: This file defines API routes for a recipe explorer backend, including endpoints for listing categories, recipes, favorites, and ratings, as well as retrieving and modifying specific resources. It uses FastAPI framework with route decorators and type annotations.

methods.name: Store _get_store(request)
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve the Store instance attached to the request's app state.

methods.name: List[Category] list_categories(request)
methods.description: Endpoint to list all recipe categories.

methods.name: SearchResponse list_recipes( request, category_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by category id."), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Text search query."), ingredients: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Comma-separated ingredient terms (AND match)." ), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list or search recipes with optional filters.

methods.name: Recipe get_recipe(request, recipe_id: str)
methods.description: Endpoint to get detailed information of a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: SearchResponse list_favorites( request, user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier (lightweight, not authenticated)."), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list a user's favorite recipes.

methods.name: Message add_favorite(request, recipe_id: str, body: FavoriteCreate)
methods.description: Endpoint to mark a recipe as favorite for a user.

methods.name: Message remove_favorite( request, recipe_id: str, user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier (lightweight, not authenticated)."), )
methods.description: Endpoint to remove a recipe from a user's favorites.

methods.name: Rating upsert_rating(request, recipe_id: str, body: RatingCreate)
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update a user's rating for a recipe.

methods.name: Optional[Rating] get_my_rating( request, recipe_id: str, user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier (lightweight, not authenticated)."), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the requesting user's rating for a specific recipe.

ctags.name: add_favorite
ctags.pattern: /^def add_favorite(request, recipe_id: str, body: FavoriteCreate) -> Message:$/

ctags.name: get_my_rating
ctags.signature: ( request, recipe_id: str, user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier (lightweight, not authenticated)."), )

ctags.name: list_favorites
ctags.signature: ( request, user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier (lightweight, not authenticated)."), )

ctags.name: list_recipes
ctags.signature: ( request, category_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by category id."), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Text search query."), ingredients: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Comma-separated ingredient terms (AND match)." ), )

ctags.name: remove_favorite
ctags.signature: ( request, recipe_id: str, user_id: str = Query(..., description="User identifier (lightweight, not authenticated)."), )

ctags.pattern: /^def upsert_rating(request, recipe_id: str, body: RatingCreate) -> Rating:$/
